## About Me

I'm **Mishal Aboobackar**, an **M.S. Applied Business Analytics** candidate at **Boston University** (GPA: 3.5, May 2026) with professional experience as a Business Analyst spanning **23 countries**. I combine technical depth in Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, and Apache Spark with a track record of measurable business outcomes.

Eligible for **STEM OPT (3-year work authorisation)**. Available for full-time roles from **June 2026**.

## What I Bring

- **Analytics & ML**: Python, SQL, R, Power BI, Tableau, Apache Spark, Scikit-learn, NLP
- **Business outcomes**: Accelerated revenue growth from 3% to 9%; reduced ERP errors by 25%; scaled CSR programme to 2,000+ beneficiaries
- **Data engineering**: ETL pipelines, PySpark, AWS EC2, Oracle, Cloudera
- **Cross-functional collaboration**: Executive stakeholder reporting across 23 country operations
